found.name: Students' Union Advice and Representation Centre
found.quote: Students who are suspected of engaging in academic misconduct under this Policy are strongly encouraged to seek independent advice and support from the Students’ Union Advice and Representation Centre.

found.name: Module and course leaders, personal tutor
found.quote: Additionally, more general advice and support in achieving sound academic practice and avoiding academic misconduct, can be provided by: • The module and course leaders • Their personal tutor • Students Union Advice and Representation Centre.

found.name: Online academic integrity learning activity
found.quote: The student may be required to undertake an online academic integrity learning activity.
